subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.**

I am ________ regular reader of ________ Times of India.
solution:
The correct answer is: **a; the**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• '**A**' is the indefinite article that is used before noun phrases.
 
• Use '**A**' when the noun or adjective that comes next begins with a consonant sound.
 
 
• **Example**
